title: MRI Hero

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: mri_hero_heading
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: Connect leasing, finance and property operations in one place.

fields.label: Content
fields.name: mri_hero_content
fields.instructions: Lead with the visitor benefit, then add one approved proof point. The 45,000+ client figure is current on MRI-owned pages but should still follow brand approval.
fields.default_value: Give your teams a clearer view of portfolio performance with open and connected real estate software trusted by 45,000+ clients worldwide.

fields.label: Logo Image
fields.name: mri_hero_logo_image
fields.instructions: Select an approved MRI image from the media library. Use imagery that supports this section rather than repeating nearby content.

fields.label: Benefits
fields.name: mri_hero_benefits
fields.instructions: Add enough items to explain the story clearly. Keep item length and structure consistent, and remove any unused example rows.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Explain the visitor benefit in plain language. Be specific about the workflow or outcome, and avoid jargon or unsupported claims.
sub_fields.default_value: Unify property, lease and financial data

fields.label: Form Title
fields.name: mri_hero_form_title
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.

fields.label: Embed Code
fields.name: mri_hero_embed_code
fields.instructions: Paste only the approved form embed code. Test submission, validation, consent and analytics before launch.
fields.default_value: <!-- Paste the approved MRI form embed code here -->

fields.label: Footer
fields.name: mri_hero_footer
fields.instructions: Use concise, benefit-led copy that is specific to the page audience and consistent with approved MRI messaging.
fields.default_value: Tell us about your portfolio and we’ll focus the conversation on your priorities.

fields.label: Terms Copy
fields.name: mri_hero_terms_copy
fields.instructions: Legal copy must be approved for the visitor region, campaign and consent model. Do not publish this example without legal review.
fields.default_value: By submitting this form, you agree to the applicable MRI Software terms and privacy notice and consent to being contacted about our products or services.

description: Defaults are MRI-focused examples for a commercial real estate marketing landing page. Adapt to the campaign audience, product and region; verify every claim, customer reference and legal statement before publishing.
ai_description: Generate concise, benefit-led MRI Software landing-page copy. Emphasise open and connected real estate technology, connected leasing/finance/operations workflows, portfolio visibility and flexibility. Do not invent metrics, reviews, awards, prices, customer names or implementation timelines.
